raw_comment:
I noticed in the United States map that the upper and lower parts of the country are experiencing more drought. 
I wonder why most coastal areas are experiencing less drought than the ones in Midwest states.
 This relates to my community because these droughts are warming the climate.
 Catchy Headline: Will the spread of droughts continue, or will it stop?
